pattern: ても構わない（てもかまわない）
purpose: Give permission or say that a choice causes no problem.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Verb / adjective ても-form; noun / な-adjective + でも + 構わない
Would it be all right if I sat here?
It does not matter if you are a little late.
formation: Verb / adjective ても-form; noun / な-adjective + でも + 構わない
restrictions: Permission can sound detached; context determines warmth.
mistake: For asking permission add ですか; the declarative form grants or accepts it.
